key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unconditional inline d.set(nullptr), so it can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown, and it leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard at the qcollator call site; (B) adds an exported QThreadStorageData::clear() that does that check itself, making clearLocalData() the one shutdown-safe accessor and letting qcollator drop its private qthread_p.h workaround.
